purpose: Track auditable requests for independent physical hydrogen-refuelling data without treating a request, paper, plot or simulator output as validation.
claim_boundary: This tracker is a data-acquisition plan. It is not evidence of validation, does not change any IJHE readiness gate, and does not authorize contact or publication.

required_for_full_loop: independent provenance and immutable file digest
written reuse terms permitting derived results in an open repository and journal
preferred: storage-bank, compressor, precooler and dispenser state
alarm, abort, maintenance and calibration flags
freeze_protocol: quarantine received files before reading outcomes
record source URL, access date, licence and SHA-256
freeze eligible cases, split, implementation commit and error screens
run once without case-specific fitting or time warping
retain every eligible failure and publish the claim boundary

candidates.minimum_acceptance: At least eight eligible fills with common time base and vehicle/receptacle pressure plus mass flow or transferred mass.
candidates.rights: De-identification and written reuse permission required; public report alone is context only.
candidates.next_action: Project owner reviews and sends the draft to CARB data custodian.
candidates.claim_boundary: No full-loop claim until raw workbook and rights are frozen.

candidates.minimum_acceptance: A de-identified holdout with common time base, tank capacity, initial conditions and protocol metadata.
candidates.rights: NREL/NFCTEC release terms and permission for derived metrics must be documented.
candidates.next_action: Project owner contacts the published technical-validation custodian.
candidates.claim_boundary: Public composite products remain operating-range context only.

candidates.minimum_acceptance: De-identified synchronized test matrices for eligible stations with calibration and protocol metadata.
candidates.rights: Report identifies station data as confidential; written release terms are mandatory.
candidates.next_action: Route a separate request to CARB/NREL/CEC custodians identified by the report.
candidates.claim_boundary: The public report cannot close a numerical holdout.

candidates.minimum_acceptance: Original synchronized logger exports for both pressure classes; summary CSVs are insufficient.
candidates.rights: Author or publisher permission must cover derived error metrics and redistribution of derived tables.
candidates.next_action: Project owner sends author request using the draft.
candidates.claim_boundary: Published endpoints are face-validity context, not holdout evidence.

candidates.candidate_type: independent heavy-duty fill and precooling traces
candidates.minimum_acceptance: At least four eligible fills across pressure or temperature groups with common timestamps.
candidates.rights: Custodian must state whether anonymized traces and derived figures may be deposited and published.
candidates.next_action: Project owner sends request to corresponding author/data custodian.
candidates.claim_boundary: Paper-level plots remain a request lead until machine-readable files are obtained.

candidates.minimum_acceptance: De-identified synchronized refuelling runs with capacity and pressure-ramp metadata.
candidates.rights: DLR/project consortium permission and citation terms required.
candidates.next_action: Project owner sends the prepared DLR request.
candidates.claim_boundary: The IJHE article is independent field evidence but not a raw holdout.

candidates.candidate_type: independent Empa Type-IV and rail refuelling measurements
candidates.minimum_acceptance: Raw synchronized traces or a documented route to the underlying Empa/FCH2RAIL logger files.
candidates.rights: Data owner must approve derived publication and repository deposition.
candidates.next_action: Send after identifying the corresponding data custodian.
candidates.claim_boundary: Open article access does not imply raw-data reuse permission.

candidates.candidate_type: independent dispenser metrology and field-fill traces
candidates.minimum_acceptance: Raw synchronized files with instrument calibration and test-condition metadata.
candidates.rights: NIST/data custodian must confirm reuse and publication terms.
candidates.next_action: Send request through NIST project contact.
candidates.claim_boundary: Metrology evidence may validate a sub-boundary rather than a complete station loop.

candidates.minimum_acceptance: Machine-readable 18-file campaign or a defined subset with synchronized pressure and flow.
candidates.rights: JRC/HyTransfer reuse terms and immutable source archive required.
candidates.next_action: Send the request to the JRC/GasTeF custodian.
candidates.claim_boundary: Campaign data can validate tank/fill submodels unless station-control channels are present.

candidates.minimum_acceptance: De-identified operational traces covering multiple complete fills and declared exclusion rules.
candidates.rights: Author statement cites legal/consent restrictions; written permission is required.
candidates.next_action: Send the prepared author request.
candidates.claim_boundary: Published comparison figures alone cannot be scored as an untouched holdout.

candidates.minimum_acceptance: Event-level or time-series exports with enough common timestamps for independent replay.
candidates.rights: Institutional custodian must approve de-identification, derived metrics and repository deposit.
candidates.next_action: Send request to HRFF authors/data custodian.
candidates.claim_boundary: Aggregate multi-year performance is operating context only.

candidates.candidate_type: independent British Columbia H70 dispenser events
candidates.minimum_acceptance: De-identified synchronized event traces, not only aggregate plots or counts.
candidates.rights: NRC/data owner must document licence and derived-publication permission.
candidates.next_action: Send request to NRC report custodian.
candidates.claim_boundary: The public report remains fault-taxonomy and operating-range context.

candidates.minimum_acceptance: Raw synchronized release or detector traces with geometry and calibration metadata.
candidates.rights: NRC or HTEC custodian must approve publication and redistribution terms.
candidates.next_action: Identify the report-specific custodian, then send the draft.
candidates.claim_boundary: Leakage data support consequence/detector submodels, not station controller validation unless station state is present.

candidates.minimum_acceptance: Chronological raw channels with sensor map, units and quality flags.
candidates.rights: Corresponding author/data owner must confirm reuse.
candidates.next_action: Send after confirming the corresponding author contact.
candidates.claim_boundary: Sensor monitoring can validate signal logic; it is not automatically a full-loop fill holdout.

candidates.minimum_acceptance: Machine-readable synchronized traces and test-condition metadata for untouched cases.
candidates.rights: Author or publisher must permit derived metrics and repository deposit.
candidates.next_action: Send prepared request to corresponding author.
candidates.claim_boundary: Paper and plotted traces are not counted until raw files and rights are frozen.

candidates.minimum_acceptance: Six or more synchronized fills with enough metadata for no-fit replay.
candidates.rights: JHFC/NEDO or data custodian permission required.
candidates.next_action: Send request through JHFC/NEDO contact route.
candidates.claim_boundary: Published article endpoints are context only.

candidates.minimum_acceptance: Approved file-tree export with common timestamps and rights for derived publication.
candidates.rights: Repository marks the files approval-required; access and reuse authorization must be recorded.
candidates.next_action: Submit repository access request and retain approval record.
candidates.claim_boundary: Metadata listing is not a validation dataset.

candidates.minimum_acceptance: Row-level synchronized logger files beyond the public aggregate charts.
candidates.rights: UCI/NFCRC data custodian must confirm reuse terms.
candidates.next_action: Send request using the supplementary-artifact lead.
candidates.claim_boundary: Aggregate charts are field context only.

candidates.candidate_type: duplicate author route for 35/70 MPa field tests
candidates.minimum_acceptance: Original logger files and rights statement; summary CSVs do not qualify.
candidates.rights: Author/publisher permission required.
candidates.next_action: Use one coordinated request with the CIP route to avoid duplicate outreach.
candidates.claim_boundary: Do not double-count the same experiment under two request routes.

candidates.minimum_acceptance: De-identified synchronized traces with units, initial conditions, provenance, quality flags and written reuse terms; freeze hash and protocol before numerical scoring.
candidates.rights: No public raw-data licence identified; require written permission for derived metrics and figures.
candidates.next_action: Project-owner review of research/GTI_DATA_REQUEST_DRAFT.md, then contact the custodian if authorised.
candidates.claim_boundary: Report provenance and a data-request lead only until an untouched export is received and prospectively scored.
